title: POP Filter Common Page
summary: Official Derivative common page for POP filter operators, covering Bypass, Free Extra GPU Memory, and Delete Input Attributes behavior for POPs that process incoming data.
guidance: Use this article when a POP filter plan needs common pass-through, memory-release, or attribute-pruning behavior.
Bypass passes through the first input unchanged, which is useful for safe toggles in generated POP networks.
Free Extra GPU Memory can release memory accumulated from changing output memory sizes.
Delete Input Attributes helps branch a POP stream with only the attributes explicitly specified by the filter.
